property_summary: For any caller and any calldata/value, when the Owner calls Command forwarding some ETH, the contract C forwards the same ETH value to the target (so the call succeeds with value and may transfer ETH) — the mutant using staticcall disallows value transfer, so for some calldata/value the mutant will behave differently (the call will not forward ETH and may fail or not transfer funds).
change_summary: Replace external call adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with a low-level staticcall (disallowing value transfer) which will change behavior when Command attempts to send Ether or modify state on target.
